d: Short, choppy dark purple hair with asymmetrical bangs and a single long strand framing the face. Sharp, amber-colored eyes with a focused expression, featuring a mechanical, purple-glowing ocular implant over the left eye. The face appears that of a teenager with a slender build and a curvy silhouette. A black long-sleeved dress with a white collar, black tie, and a pleated skirt, paired with black over-the-knee socks; the outfit is complemented by large, dark grey mechanical ship riggings mounted on the back and a mechanical headset with purple lights.
